messages:
auditor_erin: Hi team — prepping ISO/SOC2 fieldwork. Need an evidence bundle that ties RBAC edits (k8s RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding and IAM policy updates) to KMS operations (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt) for window 2025-08-12T00:00Z -> 2025-08-15T00:00Z. Must include signed manifest + per-file SHA256, a short control mapping to SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO A.9/A.12, and a small sanitized sample row.

kesha: Understood. Do you need admin-console and terraform-run events included? We keep those in admin_audit and infra_runs indexes.

auditor_erin: Yes include both. EKM/HSM optional; start with CMKs. Consolidated bundle across prod regions is fine.

miguel: Plan: 1) export cloudtrail (eventName in Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt, CreateGrant), 2) k8s audit for rolebinding/clusterrolebinding changes, 3) admin_audit and infra_runs, 4) correlate and compute correlation_score with clear rules. Provide raw + redacted CSVs.

kesha: Splunk queries I'll run (prod):
```spl
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=CreateGrant)
| eval ts=_time
| table ts, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, requestParameters.keyAlias, sourceIPAddress, userAgent
| sort ts
```

```spl
index=k8s_audit (objectRef.resource=rolebindings OR objectRef.resource=clusterrolebindings)
| table _time, user.username, verb, objectRef.resource, objectRef.name, requestObject
```

```spl
index=admin_audit OR index=infra_runs
| table _time, actor, action, details
```

miguel: Correlation rules (documented in scoring_rules.md): time_window default +/- 180s (weight 45), token issuer/OIDC sub match (30), IP + userAgent similarity (15), infra/admin reference match (10). score normalized 0..1. We'll include pseudocode and an example computation.

kesha: Staging (unsigned) bundle: s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1899999000-rbac-kms-evidence.zip. Contents: cloudtrail.csv, k8s_audit.csv, admin_audit.csv, infra_runs.csv, correlation.csv, scoring_rules.md, control_map.md, README.md, manifest.json. We'll sign manifest.json with alias/audit-sign and move to evidence/.

miguel: Example pseudo-SQL join I'll run in analytics cluster: 
```sql
SELECT r._time AS rb_time, r.user_username AS rb_actor, r.objectRef_name AS rb_object, r.verb AS rb_change_type,
       k.ts AS kms_time, k.userIdentity_arn AS kms_actor, k.requestParameters_keyId AS key_id,
       k.requestParameters_keyAlias AS key_alias, compute_score(...) AS correlation_score,
       inc.incident_id AS incident_id,
       's3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1899999000/manifest.json.sig' AS manifest_ref
FROM k8s_audit r
LEFT JOIN cloudtrail k ON abs(r._time - k.ts) <= 180
LEFT JOIN admin_audit a ON a._time BETWEEN r._time - 300 AND r._time + 300
LEFT JOIN infra_runs t ON t.run_window OVERLAPS r._time
LEFT JOIN incident_index inc ON inc.window CONTAINS r._time;
```

kesha: Signing flow we'll run (example):
```bash
aws s3 cp ./1899999000-rbac-kms-evidence.zip s3://redwood-compliance/temp/
aws kms sign --key-id alias/audit-sign --message fileb://manifest.json --signature fileb://manifest.json.sig
aws s3 mv s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1899999000-rbac-kms-evidence.zip s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1899999000-rbac-kms-evidence.zip
```

evidence-bot: INCIDENT 2025-08-13T03:12Z - autoscaler rollback recorded. ID: INC-20250813-3

auditor_erin: Please ensure any rows tied to INC-20250813-3 are annotated and show who initiated RBAC rollbacks and whether ephemeral keys (alias/ephemeral/*) were used. Also include retention notes per index.

miguel: Will do. Retention: CloudTrail 180d, k8s_audit 90d, admin_audit 365d, infra_runs 365d. We'll add redaction rules in README (emails hashed, IP last-octet masked). ETA for signed bundle: ~5 hours, will DM presigned link.

kesha: Example sanitized row for README (emails redacted, ids truncated):
"rbac_1723456000 | dana[at]redwood (redacted) | RoleBinding:prod-autoscaler | patch | kms_1723456042 | svc-account-autoscaler | key/9f8a-xxxx | alias/ephemeral/autoscaler | 0.93 | INC-20250813-3 | s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1899999000/manifest.json.sig"

auditor_erin: Great 44d We'll review on receipt and request ekm_audit if needed. Thanks!
